notes.content: This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s). CSCI/MATH 217 is an approved major course substitution for Critical Thinking (1B).
notes.contentHtml:
This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s).

  • CSCI/MATH 217 is an approved major course substitution for Critical Thinking (1B).

notes.content: A grade of C- or higher is required in all Computer Science (CSCI), and Electrical/Electronic Engineering (EECE) courses used for the major. Each CSCI course may be attempted no more than three times each. After a third attempt with a grade below C- in any single required CSCI course, a student will not be able to complete the major. Enrollment in any mathematics course requires a grade of C- or higher in all prerequisite courses or their transfer equivalents.
notes.contentHtml:
• A grade of C- or higher is required in all Computer Science (CSCI), and Electrical/Electronic Engineering (EECE) courses used for the major.
  • Each CSCI course may be attempted no more than three times each.
  • After a third attempt with a grade below C- in any single required CSCI course, a student will not be able to complete the major.
  • Enrollment in any mathematics course requires a grade of C- or higher in all prerequisite courses or their transfer equivalents.
